### Fixes

- Product references respect sales-channel visibility and resolve through SEO URL generation. SKU lookups are batched and repeated references memoized, so a page with many references no longer issues one query per reference (#39)
- Renderer settings now agree between ordinary and context-aware output, which previously could render the same document two ways on one page (#39)
- Admin preview requests reject stale responses and show a failure inside a sandboxed iframe rather than silently keeping the previous render (#39)
- Fragment ids and tab radio groups stay independent across several rendered blocks on one page (#39)
- Imported review HTML is wrapped in a block container, and images and tables adapt to narrow screens (#39)
- Diagram library versions are pinned, the Kroki endpoint is configurable, and charts keep their data alternative (#39)

### Improvements

- One shared Carve editor across the CMS element and the product, category and manufacturer fields, with server-side preview, diagnostics, product and media selection, and reviewed HTML and Markdown import (#39)
- Commerce authoring elements: sales-channel prices, stock labels, cards, grids, specification lists, datasheets, media images, snippets and internal links (#39)
- Shared content includes: an include library to select from, write checks on publication, dependency cache tags, and `carve:includes:invalidate` for deployment jobs (#39)
- Configurable CMS field mapping, copy placement and external-link behavior, automatic typography locale, literal-data escaping for mail, and headless CMS component examples (#39)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/markup-carve/shopware-carve/compare/0.1.4...0.1.5
